_comment: The BitFS squish-cancel pipeline as it was last run from main.cpp. Paths are relative to this file; the build writes a copy next to bitfs-turn.exe with baseDirectory pointing here. README.md documents the schema, `bitfs-turn --list` the stage types.

visualize._comment: Defaults for every stage's visualize block: a 900-by-900 window centered on the pyramid (home x -1945, z -715; the plot's x is MarioZ and its y MarioX), never rescaled.

stages._comment: The ARE fixer (ROADMAP 4.8), no search: from the movie's dive onto the platform (frame 3269 is its dive slide), a dive recover whose rollout is steered in the air (no A: the run is an A button challenge) to land where the pyramid rests with the target's adjusted remainder error on both axes and the step parity the oscillations need. Every later stage starts at 3269 too, since its solutions do. bitfs-turn --test checks it.
stages.name: are-fix

stages._comment: Build up oscillations one at a time from the equilibrium frame the ARE fixer found.
stages.name: dr

stages._comment: The final oscillation into the target quadrant, from the oscillation solutions.
stages.name: osc-final

stages._comment: The dive-recover chain, disabled in the old main.cpp and never run to completion: dive from the oscillation solutions, land it, then the C-up trick.
stages.name: dr-approach
